scope: Pinned CPU small-model screen; native precision then reduced precision only if the frozen research gate passes.
limitations: 24 authored cases repeated under 3 option orders, not 72 independent quality samples.
Host guard overlay is not the complete hybrid retrieval, fallback, lifecycle or final UI guard path. Raw quality is reported independently so an always-hold guarded system cannot pass.
Laya HTTP response time and GLiNER in-process time use different transports; latency is not a hardware-normalized model ranking.
All downloaded decision checkpoints are local; no hosted decision or teacher-label calls.
No deployment promotion or probability calibration from this authored development set.
